messages:
Maya (support): Hey team, customer reports repeated 429s yesterday even though their Quota panel shows 0 usage for the day. They say enforcement still throttled calls. Attaching repro steps from the customer below.

Maya (support): Repro they gave: 1) Make 50 short /v1/generate calls in a loop (small prompts). 2) Observe 429s after ~20 calls. 3) Check Console -> Usage -> Quotas for the org -> shows 0/100k for the day.

Maya (support): They pasted this header from a failed request: `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 1670000`. Also sent a snippet of the error body: `{"error":"quota_exceeded","code":429}"`.

Eli (eng-infra): Thanks, Maya. Can you drop the raw request-id and timestamp? I'll pull enforcement decision logs.

Maya (support): Sure — request-id `req_0a1b2c3d`. Timestamp 2026-03-15T18:12:02Z.

Eli (eng-infra): Quick check: enforcement service shows a hit against a per-customer token bucket (policy id 42). It returned THROTTLED with remaining=0 at 18:12:02Z for req_0a1b2c3d. But the quota-indexer topic shows no update for that org for the day. Strange.

Priya (analytics): @Eli, did the metrics pipeline ingest for the quota-stream lag yesterday? We had ingestion backlog for ~40m around 17:30-18:10 UTC due to a transient consumer restart.

Eli (eng-infra): I see a consumer restart but the enforcement decisions are on a different path (enforcer consults Redis + local counters). Could be a stale sync between enforcement counters and the UI read model.

Jon (serving): Do we have any TTL or rounding logic in the aggregator that could zero out daily buckets when summary writer restarts? I remember a previous bug where a missing key produced a 0 display.

Priya (analytics): Good call. I'll run a quick materialized view check. Patch query I plan to run:

```
SELECT org_id, date_bucket, sum(usage) as total
FROM quota_daily_summary
WHERE org_id = 'org_17x' AND date_bucket = '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY org_id, date_bucket;
```

Priya (analytics): Also checking the raw kafka topic for events from 17:00-19:00: `kafka-console-consumer --from-beginning --topic quota-events --partition 3 --offset 12345`

Eli (eng-infra): I also pulled Redis for that org around the time: `HGETALL quota:org_17x:daily:2026-03-15` and it returned an empty map at 18:11:59Z. Enforcement still had an in-memory counter at ~22 calls remaining before the 429s — suggests a race where UI read key expired but the enforcer used a persistent bucket that still enforced limits.

Maya (support): Customer says they were actively using the product, not idle. They need a timeline so we can explain — any ETA?

Jon (serving): Hypothesis: the aggregator service that writes to the UI can occasionally drop writes if the write-ahead queue is full; when that happens the UI shows 0 because it backfills from Redis TTL which might have been rotated. Enforcement uses a committed counter which wasn't backfilled. Repro plan: 1) Simulate high ingestion and kill aggregator writer; 2) generate traffic; 3) observe UI vs enforcement.

Eli (eng-infra): I've started an adhoc replay for the org on staging to reproduce. If we see mismatch that's the bug. For mitigation, we can temporarily disable strict enforcement for the org (soft quota) to unblock customer — but need approval.

Priya (analytics): Ran the earlier SQL — the materialized summary is NULL for that day (0 rows). Raw events in the topic confirm events exist for the org during that window. So writes didn't make it to the summary table.

Eli (eng-infra): Filed a quick internal incident: incident-2026-03-15-quota-indexer. Root cause candidate: a bug in the summary writer that ignores messages where `usage_delta` is 0 after float rounding (happens with short prompt/embedding units). That made the row never created and UI defaulted to 0. Enforcement still charged because it increments token bucket directly.

Maya (support): Customer requests timeline and we offered a temporary soft-unblock. They accepted if we can do it within 1 hour.

Jon (serving): I have a small fix ready that will ensure the writer uses an additive upsert even when `usage_delta` rounds to 0. PR #3147. I'll ship to staging now.

ops-bot: deploy started for serving/summary-writer:sha@abc123 -> staging

Eli (eng-infra): After deploy, I replayed the topic and the summary row now exists in the table. The Console shows correct ~45 calls for that day. Enforcement still returns correct headers.

Maya (support): Customer confirmed they stopped seeing new 429s after we applied the soft-unblock and then the replay. They said the UI now matches enforcement. :tada:

Maya (support): Follow-ups: 1) Jon to merge patch to prod + rollout schedule. 2) Priya to add a monitor alert when quota-summary writer emits >5% drop in writes vs topic volume. 3) Eli to document mitigation runbook (soft-unblock steps).

Jon (serving): Will open prod PR and slack a rollout ETA.

Priya (analytics): I'll add the monitor and a Grafana panel to show outgoing write failures.

Eli (eng-infra): Documenting runbook now in /internal/runbooks/quota-indexer.md (will link once committed).

Maya (support): Closing loop with customer now. Thanks everyone. :heart:
